algorithms.failure_condition: Compile the historical proof-core schema in an isolated schema registry keyed by its Git blob retrieval identity, never by its historical $id alias; fail unless the core object validates fully.
Fail on wrong order, duplicate key, duplicate id, or ambiguous normalization.
Fail unless scenario_id and assertion_id form exact one-to-one membership across all three artifacts.
Fail unless every path resolves to exactly the recorded regular-file blob at source_sha and every eligible tracked source appears once.
Fail on missing, unknown, duplicate, overlapping, or arithmetically inconsistent production or critical-surface coverage.
Fail unless every listed in-target mutant has exactly one required or excluded disposition and results equal required membership.
Fail unless each waiver id resolves uniquely, binds the same mutant, path and class, and introduced_policy_sha is already canonical and is not the candidate.
Fail unless each required context is unique, exact-head, successful, app-bound, repository-bound, workflow/job-bound, and canonical-base workflow-blob-bound.
Fail unless repository, ref, path, blob, run and artifact URL identities are reconstructed from fields and match exact retained GitHub objects.
Fail unless all 41 required roles appear once, paths are globally unique, and Git blob and raw SHA-256 match source bytes.
Fail on non-portable path, traversal, symlink component, wrong owner or link count, or containment escape.
Fail on overflow, negative values, zero denominators where prohibited, or any required count or equality mismatch.
Fail unless policy digests, schema ids, target sets, limits, exclusions, commands, and inventory source identities agree exactly.
Fail before semantic parsing on file, aggregate, format, depth, record, wall-time, or memory limit violation.
Fail unless the independently canonicalized deterministic envelope hashes exactly to outer af02_adversarial_sha256; core stochastic observations never affect this digest.
